ja361:1.1: Vaṇṇārohena jātiyā balā nikkamanena ca Subāhu na mayā seyyo Sudāṭha iti bhāsasīti.
ja361:2.1: Vaṇṇārohena jātiyā balā nikkamanena ca Sudāṭho na mayā seyyo Subāhu iti bhāsasi.
ja361:3.1: Evaṃ ce maṃ viharantaṃ Subāhu samma dubbhasi, na dān' āhaṃ tayā saddhiṃ saṃvāsam abhirocaye.
ja361:4.1: Yo paresaṃ vacanāni saddahetha yathātathaṃ khippaṃ bhijjetha mittasmiṃ verañ ca pasave bahuṃ.
ja361:5.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto bhedāsaṃkī randham evānupassī, yasmiñ ca setī urasīva putto sa ve mitto yo abhejjo parehīti.
